description: Turn OpenClaw into an autonomous social media manager for Fuxux. Schedule and publish to Twitter/X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Bluesky, Threads, and Pinterest via REST API and MCP — media, drafts, queue, and publishing analytics.
